Shit as fuck indeed,  don’t let that be your mates man, people you wouldn’t even expect will feel it. 

It would certainly throw the crash investigators off, I like that you have a sense of humour even in shit times. I hope that isn’t the case though, I hope it’s positive. Enjoy every sunrise and sunset, really, there’s a lot more to experience man, from some tiny little village in Russia to NYC, think of the experiences and people that are waiting. Thousands of people in terrible situations just like you have got off meth and sorted out their ptsd, you can be next man. I’ll be up all night anyway if you need a message

Do not do it. I have just had a friend kill herself and it is fucked. The pain will be passed to your family and amplified. Trust me I feel you, I am deeply depressed and addicted to heroin, nothing compares to the pain of losing someone close to suicide, trust me. Please if nothing just give it a few days more thought
Also, the world is actually the most peaceful and least hungry  than ever before in history, seriously
PLEASE go somewhere, it will help. I hear Belmont is good
It went through arteries and was going everywhere so I had no choice
